evidence.text:
Reason for rferral: Evaluation of fatigue in a 78-year-old woman with a strong family
history of premature heart disease.

Findings: Sinus bradycardia at 58 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 176 ms, QRS 80 ms, QTc 449
ms.
Impression: Sinus bradycardia, otherwise normal tracing.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
45%. Mild aortic valve sclerosis without stenosis. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Mildly reduced left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 155 mg/dL
LDL Cholesterol: 64 mg/dL
HDL Cholesterol: 51 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 202 mg/dL (H)

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 143 mmol/L
Potassium: 3.9 mmol/L
Chloride: 105 mmol/L
CO2: 26 mmol/L
BUN: 21 mg/dL (H)
Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL
Glucose: 159 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 9.5 mg/dL

Amlodipine 5 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 50 mcg by mouth once daily
Acetaminophen 500 mg by mouth as needed

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection
murmur, no radiation.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.
